stories.title: Octagon Can Steal SMS One-Time Codes During Banking and Crypto Account Takeovers
stories.description: Octagon is an Android stealer that captures logins, screens and verification codes, enabling account takeovers and financial fraud.

stories.title: Apple Fixes 28 Security Vulnerabilities Across macOS, iOS, and iPadOS
stories.description: Apple patches 28 macOS, iOS, and iPadOS vulnerabilities enabling data leaks, crashes, kernel access, and code execution.

stories.title: AI-Driven Vulnerability Surge Breaks the Traditional Patching Model
stories.description: Rapid7 warns that traditional patch cycles cannot keep pace with soaring vulnerability disclosures and faster exploitation, forcing defenders to prioritize exposure over severity scores.

stories.title: OpenAI Warns AI Models Can Automate Cyberattacks and Exploit Security Vulnerabilities
stories.description: OpenAI has warned that advancing artificial intelligence models are increasingly capable of automating critical phases of real-world cyberattacks.

stories.title: C2Looper Updates Itself Through OneDrive DLL Sideloading to Evade Detection
stories.description: C2Looper is a Windows backdoor that enables remote commands, network discovery and malware delivery, linked to ransomware attacks.

stories.title: AI "Mind Viruses" Can Spread Between Agents Through Persistent Prompt Files
stories.description: Anthropic and EPFL show AI mind viruses can spread through persistent agent prompt files, while a one-paragraph warning cuts spread to near zero.

stories.title: TWINLOOT Abuses SharePoint and Teams to Steal Credentials and Move Across Networks
stories.description: TWINLOOT uses SharePoint, Teams TURN, and headless Edge for C2, steals Windows credentials, and opens SOCKS5 access into victim networks.

stories.title: Xpander Raises $7.5 Million for AI Management and Governance
stories.description: Xpander’s platform uses a universal agent harness that executes AI agents as portable workloads and securely renders interfaces on demand.

stories.title: Fortinet Acquires AI Security Company Virtue AI
stories.description: Fortinet will use Virtue AI technology to enhance its AI security portfolio, including for AI models, applications, and agentic systems.

stories.title: One Attacker Has Scraped Both Salesforce and ServiceNow Portals Since 2025
stories.description: City Forum uses one server to pull records from over-permissive Salesforce and ServiceNow guest portals across industries for over a year.

stories.title: 16 Typosquatted RubyGems Packages Steal Browser Credentials and Crypto Wallets
stories.description: StubMaker uses 16 typosquatted RubyGems packages to steal browser credentials, crypto wallets, seed phrases, and Telegram data on Windows.

stories.title: 300,000 WordPress Sites Potentially Exposed to Hacking Due to Form Plugin Flaw
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-15748, the arbitrary file upload bug allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files.
